rv.q: Ms. Mendes brings a bracing physicality to what can be a static, talky play
Pablo Schreiber brings raw sexual magnetism and simmering volatility to his role as Eben, while Carla Gugino makes a persuasive Abbie, her earthy sensuality masking steely calculation.
What we get instead is a production that feels more like a high school staging of O'Neill than a Broadway revival worthy of the material's stature.
The revival features powerhouse performances from Pablo Schreiber and Carla Gugino that almost compensate for the play's creaky melodramatics.
The production succeeds best when it focuses on the elemental clash between Ephraim and Eben, with Glover and Rabe delivering performances of uncommon intensity and authenticity.
